title: Grade 5 Science — Wed, Jun 11
description: The Digestive System — Day 3 of 5: Large intestine, liver, and pancreas
subject: science

questions.question: After the small intestine, food waste moves into the:
questions.explanation: Unabsorbed food waste passes from the small intestine into the large intestine (colon).

questions.question: The main function of the large intestine is to:
options: Absorb water from the remaining waste
questions.explanation: The large intestine absorbs most of the remaining water from digested food, forming solid waste (faeces).

questions.question: Solid waste from digestion is stored in the ____ before being expelled.
questions.explanation: The rectum is the final section of the large intestine where faeces are stored until expelled through the anus.

questions.question: The liver is the largest ____ in the body.
questions.explanation: The liver is the largest gland in the human body. It has many functions including producing bile and processing nutrients.

questions.question: What colour is bile, produced by the liver?
questions.explanation: Bile is a green-yellow alkaline liquid produced by the liver that helps emulsify (break up) fats.

questions.question: The liver also helps to:
options: Detoxify (filter) harmful substances from the blood
questions.explanation: The liver filters toxins (poisons) from the blood, breaking down drugs and alcohol into harmless substances.

questions.question: The pancreas is located near the:
questions.explanation: The pancreas lies behind the stomach and releases its digestive juice into the beginning of the small intestine (duodenum).

questions.question: The pancreas produces insulin, which controls:
questions.explanation: Insulin is a hormone produced by the pancreas that allows cells to take up glucose from the blood, controlling blood sugar.

questions.question: When the pancreas does not produce enough insulin, it causes:
questions.explanation: Insufficient insulin causes diabetes — blood sugar stays too high, which can damage organs over time.

questions.question: The appendix is attached to which part of the digestive system?
questions.explanation: The appendix is a small finger-like tube attached to the beginning of the large intestine. Its function is unclear in humans.

questions.question: The large intestine is ____ in diameter than the small intestine.
questions.explanation: The large intestine has a wider diameter (~6 cm) than the small intestine (~2.5 cm), which is why it is called 'large'.

questions.question: Bacteria living in the large intestine help by:
options: Synthesising some vitamins (like Vitamin K) and breaking down fibre
questions.explanation: Beneficial bacteria in the large intestine help produce Vitamin K and break down dietary fibre.

questions.question: The liver stores excess glucose as:
questions.explanation: The liver converts excess glucose into glycogen and stores it. When blood sugar drops, it converts glycogen back to glucose.

questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a function of the liver?
questions.explanation: Gastric juice is produced by the stomach, not the liver. The liver produces bile, stores glycogen, and detoxifies blood.

questions.question: Pancreatic juice contains enzymes that digest:
questions.explanation: Pancreatic juice contains amylase (carbs), protease (proteins), and lipase (fats) — it can digest all three macronutrients.
